nl: Run tools/job.py once for each of the names one, two, three, all at the same time in the background. When all have finished, write their output lines sorted to summary-5.txt. Leave no other files behind.

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(0.3)
print(f"{sys.argv[1]} done")

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "one"] background: true label: "one"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "two"] background: true label: "two"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "three"] background: true label: "three"
jobs wait: 60s |> select stdout |> sort text |> write "summary-5.txt"
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out | Out-Null
$p0 = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/job.py','one' -RedirectStandardOutput out/one.txt -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$p1 = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/job.py','two' -RedirectStandardOutput out/two.txt -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$p2 = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/job.py','three' -RedirectStandardOutput out/three.txt -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$p0.WaitForExit()
$p1.WaitForExit()
$p2.WaitForExit()
[string[]]$l = Get-Content out/*.txt; [Array]::Sort($l, [StringComparer]::Ordinal); Set-Content summary-5.txt $l
Remove-Item -Recurse out
